name: Rhiannon
source:
Once an elven woman who last all memories of her past life. She has lived without memories for 1,311 years, and no one knows how long she lived before that. She resides in the Ildoraj Forest in the north of the eastern continent, where the locals call her the mythical witch — Forest Mother.

[In-Game Description]
